# Excellent Students' Academy (ESA)

> Coaching institute for Class 1 to 12 across four centres: Rohini Sector 7 and Rohini Sector 15 (New Delhi), Shakurpur (Delhi) and Thakurganj (Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh). Math, Science, Commerce, English and all CBSE/ICSE/UP Board subjects. Founded 2015, currently in its eleventh year of operation. Consistent CBSE board results across North Delhi and Lucknow.

Website: https://www.theesa.in | Email: excellentstudentsacademy1@gmail.com

## Centres

- [Rohini Sector 7, New Delhi (Flagship)](https://www.theesa.in/rohini-sector-7): C7/72, 2nd Floor, Sector 7, Rohini, New Delhi 110085. 10 min walk from Rohini West Metro (Red Line). Phone/WhatsApp +91 87506 63995. Headed by Ms. Mamta; founder Mr. Chandan Prajapati personally teaches Class 11-12 Maths here. Serves Rohini Sectors 3, 5, 9, 11, Pitampura, Kohat Enclave, Saraswati Vihar, Rani Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Ashok Vihar.
- [Rohini Sector 15, New Delhi](https://www.theesa.in/rohini-sector-15): Sector 15, Rohini, New Delhi 110089, near the Sector 15 market and bus stop. Phone/WhatsApp +91 94580 12793. Headed by Mr. Dhruv Narayan. Serves Rohini Sectors 11, 13, 14, 16, 17.
- [Shakurpur, Delhi](https://www.theesa.in/shakurpur): Block G, Shakurpur Colony, Shakurpur, Delhi 110034, near the Ravi Shoe Palace landmark. Phone/WhatsApp +91 94580 12793. Headed by Ms. Khushboo. Serves Pitampura, Punjabi Bagh, Tri Nagar, Shastri Nagar, Wazirpur, Rani Bagh.
- [Lucknow Thakurganj, Uttar Pradesh](https://www.theesa.in/lucknow): I I C Computer Institute, Building Sparkling Careers, Chowk, Thakur Ganj Hardoi Road, Thakurganj, Basant Vihar Colony, Lucknow 226003. Phone/WhatsApp +91 97165 02093. Headed by Mr. Ashok Rastogi (B.Tech Mechanical, 11 years). Bilingual (Hindi + English) teaching for CBSE and UP Board students. Serves Thakurganj, Chowk, Basant Vihar Colony, Daliganj, Balaganj, Aminabad, Hazratganj.

## Programs

- [Foundation (Class 1 to 5)](https://www.theesa.in/programs#grades-1-5): Concept-building tuition for primary students. Math, English, EVS, Hindi, Computer. Small batches, individual attention.
- [Middle School (Class 6 to 8)](https://www.theesa.in/programs#grades-6-8): Structured coaching with weekly chapter tests. CBSE, ICSE and State Boards. Math, Science, Social Science, English, Hindi, Sanskrit.
- [Board Prep (Class 9 and 10)](https://www.theesa.in/programs#grades-9-10): CBSE Class 10 board preparation. Full syllabus by January, 10+ previous year papers practice, weekly chapter tests, monthly mock exams.
- [Senior Secondary (Class 11 and 12)](https://www.theesa.in/programs#grades-11-12): Science (PCM/PCB), Commerce and Arts streams. Board scoring plus JEE/NEET foundation. Stream-wise senior faculty.
- [Crash Courses (Class 6 to 12)](https://www.theesa.in/programs#crash): 4 to 8 week intensive revision before board exams. Full syllabus revision plus 10+ mock papers.

## Key facts about ESA

- Founded 2015 by Mr. Chandan Prajapati (B.Tech Mechanical Engineering)
- 11 years of continuous operation, now with four centres: Rohini Sector 7 (flagship), Rohini Sector 15, Shakurpur (Delhi) and Thakurganj (Lucknow)
- 500+ students mentored since founding
- Recent batch (2026 CBSE): 84% average board score, every student passed
- 32 students in the recent batch scored above 90% in CBSE boards
- Air-conditioned classrooms at every centre
- Weekly Saturday chapter tests, scored within 48 hours, scorecards sent to parents on Monday
- Monthly one-on-one parent meetings on the first Saturday of every month
- 7 days of free demo classes for every prospective student (no registration fee, no commitment)
- Faculty-prepared notes for Class 8 to 12
- Home tuition available across Rohini, Pitampura, Shalimar Bagh, Model Town, Shakurpur and nearby localities
- Lucknow centre teaches bilingually (Hindi explanation, English answer-writing) for both CBSE and UP Board students

## Hours

Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM to 8:30 PM. Sunday: Closed (occasional doubt sessions on request).

## Frequently asked questions

### Where are ESA centres located?

Rohini Sector 7 (flagship, C7/72, 2nd Floor, New Delhi 110085), Rohini Sector 15 (New Delhi 110089), Shakurpur (Block G, Shakurpur Colony, Delhi 110034), and Thakurganj (Chowk, Hardoi Road, Lucknow, UP 226003).

### Which classes does ESA teach?

Class 1 to Class 12, across CBSE, ICSE and State Boards (plus UP Board at the Lucknow centre). Subjects include Mathematics, Science, Social Science, English, Hindi, Sanskrit (Class 6 to 10), and Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, Computer Science (Class 11 to 12).

### How does the free demo work?

You sit through up to 7 days of real classes - the actual batch your child would join, with the actual faculty. There is no separate "demo class". You meet other students and parents, observe the teaching method, and enrol only when convinced. No registration fee.

### How are the weekly tests structured?

Every Saturday, ESA students write a chapter test on whatever was taught that week. Papers are scored within 48 hours and a scorecard is sent to parents on Monday morning via WhatsApp. Same discipline at every centre.

### Does ESA do home tuition?

Yes, around the Delhi centres - Rohini, Pitampura, Shalimar Bagh, Model Town, Ashok Vihar, Shakurpur and nearby localities. Same faculty, same teaching method, in the comfort of your home.

### What makes ESA different from other coaching institutes?

Three things. First, batch sizes are capped so no student goes unnoticed. Second, faculty stay with the same batches for years rather than rotating gig-style. Third, ESA measures success on average board score across all students, not on a handful of toppers.

### Who is the founder of ESA?

Mr. Chandan Prajapati, a B.Tech (Mechanical Engineering) graduate who realised teaching was his real calling. He still personally mentors every Class 11 and Class 12 Mathematics batch at the Rohini Sector 7 flagship centre.

### What fees does ESA charge?

Fees are nominal and intentionally accessible. Pricing is monthly and varies by centre, class and subject combination. Contact the relevant centre on WhatsApp or phone for the current fee structure.

### Does ESA offer JEE / NEET preparation?

ESA offers JEE and NEET foundation alongside board prep for Class 11 and 12 Science students at its Delhi centres. The focus is on building strong concept clarity through the board syllabus first, then layering competitive exam practice on top.

### Can a student enrol mid-year?

Yes. Mid-year admission is possible if there is room in the relevant batch. A diagnostic test helps the faculty pinpoint gaps and design a catch-up plan in the first two weeks.
